description: Value investing, growth, ETF and portfolio-review skills with an evidence-first memo contract

interface.shortDescription: Equity research skills for US/HK stocks
interface.longDescription: Eight composable agent skills for fundamental research on US and Hong Kong listed companies: filings and financial quality, business economics and moat, growth, valuation ranges with reverse DCF, falsifiable theses, ETF analysis and portfolio review. Output is a sourced investment memo, never a buy/sell signal.
